scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts._clean:unix: rm -rf `find client -name '*.js*'` && rm -rf `find public -name '*.js*'` && rm -rf `find server -name '*.js*'` && rm -rf `find imports -name '*.js*'`
scripts._clean:windows: Get-ChildItem -r -i client | Where{$_.Name -Match '*.\.js*.'} | rm -r -fo && Get-ChildItem -r -i public | Where{$_.Name -Match '*.\.js*.'} | rm -r -fo && Get-ChildItem -r -i server | Where{$_.Name -Match '*.\.js*.'} | rm -r -fo

');process.exit(1);}"
